gloss_en: the kevesh — the inclined ramp ascending the Temple altar (כֶּבֶשׁ, Yoma ch. 2), which the priests ran up to win the terumat ha-deshen, homiletically linked to kivshono shel olam, the hidden secrets/depths of the world (Chagigah 13); NOT כֶּבֶשׂ 'lamb/sheep' and not the verb כָּבַשׁ 'to conquer/subdue'
